performance_table.source: revision_table covers baseline and every revision; measured entries match selected full-model curve points
performance_table.record_policy: Only measured full-model values create curve points. revision_table includes baseline and every revision; missing values carry explicit model_status and create no curve point. Standalone timings never substitute for model TPS.
performance_table.optimization_policy: Each numerical row supplies main_improvement from its implemented source and verified plan; baseline identifies the starting baseline. Missing explanations stay explicit and never invent optimizations.
